question: Who is the Chief Justice of Bangladesh as of May 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Syed Mahmud Hossain.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Bangladesh has appointed **Syed Mahmud Hossain**** **as the new Chief Justice.
 
• Hossain is the 22nd chief justice of Bangladesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sheikh Hasina **was elected as the Prime Minister of Bangladesh for the fourth time and third consecutive time.

 
 
• She was the Prime Minister from 1996-2001, 2009-2014, 2014-2019, 2019-Current
 
• She belongs to Awami League.
 
 
 
• **Abdul Hamid Lahori** was a historian and traveller who later became a court historian of Shah Jahan.
